_readme: Data-quality policy. Every BLOCKER either has an approved cleaning rule (applied in the silver layer, and only within its tolerance) or must be zero. A blocker that is neither cleaned within tolerance nor covered by an unexpired exception in dq_exceptions.json fails the run. WARN and INFO findings are logged for review and never stop the run. Thresholds live here, not in SQL, so a change is reviewed and versioned.

claims_without_eligibility.cleaning_rule: Dropped in silver by an inner join to eligibility; dollars removed are reported and reconciled.

duplicate_member_months.cleaning_rule: De-duplicated in silver to one row per member-month.

large_claims.cleaning_rule: Capped at the line's pooling point (config/experience_parameters.json) in silver; the excess is reported as a pooling charge in the assumption indications, to be added back when an all-in claim cost is set from pooled experience.

claim_reversals.cleaning_rule: Kept; netted against originals within the incurred month.
